srd.line: Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor), Uncommon
srd.text:
_Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor), Uncommon_

Mithral is a light, flexible metal. Armor made of this substance can be worn under normal clothes. If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.

notModeled: If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.
